author: twistingtornado
quote:
GTA VI tries to change the rules of GTA, and in the process, stops being GTA. The storyline is a hackneyed Bonnie and Clyde romance with forgettable characters. For this storyline, hookers were cut from the game. The first thing I ever heard about GTA when I was a kid was "you can run over hookers!" That's been replaced with "you can buy your girlfriend flowers!" Yeah, none of the kids are saying that.

But even worse, R* invented a social credit score to punish players for killing civilians and cops without abandon during the storyline. If either Lucia or Jason fall into the psycho categorization (or stay psycho too long and become irredeemable), cops will no longer try to arrest and always try to kill no matter the wanted rating. You also end up with the bad ending. The bad ending results in both MCs dying like Bonnie and Clyde. Real original. And the six star level rating is inescapable, further punishing players for being too violent. Cops also don't automatically forget you and still search for you after evading them.

While it was nice to see Niko again, seeing him was a reminder of the stark contrast between older GTA titles and GTA VI. GTA was a crime drama sandbox. GTA VI is a romance thriller whose storyline is more important than giving the player freedom in an open sandbox. It's a fundamental shift. Gone are the jokes of Niko shooting up a Cluckin' Bell and griping about being trapped in a cycle of crime and violence in story mode. Gone are the days of feeling invincible after escaping a maximum-star wanted rating.

No more ruthless Tommy, man of the people CJ, tragic Niko, or psycho Trevor. Welcome to reserved Jason and girlboss Lucia. Welcome to not being allowed to steal your neighbor's car. Welcome to not being to shoot up a club. Welcome to gameplay mechanics that convinces users that shooting limbs is not lethal. Welcome to a game where going psycho and massacring a town gets met with consequences. 

This game is an insult to players who played GTA when R* nearly went bankrupt due to the hot coffee mod. GTA VI made one unforgivable mistake to earn 0 points. You can pick the game. But you can't change the rules.
